items.title: Submit missing financing documents (payslips, Grundbuchauszug, Teilungserklärung)
items.quote: Wir brauchen die Unterlagen innerhalb von 8 Werktagen, gerechnet ab dem Tag nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens; Samstage zählen mit, Sonn- und Feiertage nicht.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 02.10.2025. The stated start is the day after the letter date, i.e. Fri 03.10.2025. That day is the Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, which the letter itself excludes from the count ('Sonn- und Feiertage nicht'), so it is not Werktag 1; the first countable Werktag is Sat 04.10.2025 (Saturdays explicitly count). Counting forward, treating each Mon-Sat day that is not a public holiday as one Werktag: Day1=Sat 04.10, Day2=Mon 06.10, Day3=Tue 07.10, Day4=Wed 08.10, Day5=Thu 09.10, Day6=Fri 10.10, Day7=Sat 11.10, Day8=Mon 13.10.2025 (Sun 12.10 excluded). This is a private deadline (not a statutory authority period), so no further weekend/holiday-end shift rule applies beyond the Werktage definition already used; the 8th Werktag, Mon 13.10.2025, is itself a normal working day so no further adjustment is needed.

warnings: The sender's name, the address ('Musterlüne'), the applicant's name ('Beispielgaard') and other details are generic German placeholder/sample names ('Muster…', 'Beispiel…'), suggesting this document may be a template or specimen rather than genuine individual correspondence; verify authenticity before acting on it.

Because this is a deadline set unilaterally by a private bank (not a statutory period), the exact start-of-count treatment of a public holiday as the nominal first day is an interpretation choice; double-check with the bank if the exact cut-off date matters for keeping the quoted interest rate.
